summary: Live lists expose native continuation metadata and v2 --all follows every next page.
reason: Readwise v2 page lists omit the generated cursor parameter, so the shared helper must normalize it to page before both single-page metadata and --all traversal. Reader opaque cursors and next-page URLs must survive flattening, with truthful terminal signals and actionable, shell-safe continuation hints. This downstream repair covers the confirmed Readwise manifestation pending generator support.
markers: // Readwise v2 page lists omit the generated cursor parameter.
reapply: Normalize an empty cursorParam to page for page pagination at paginatedGet entry, before both branches. Follow API next URL page tokens for --all and stop on explicit next:null. Capture single-page metadata before flattening and share it with live provenance and stderr. Preserve API cursor values and api_count without legacy meta.count. For page/offset reads, omit has_more without a real paging key. Advertise --all only with a usable next_cursor or an advanceable page/offset shape; preserve bare truncated events otherwise. Validate native flags against the command, shell-quote human cursor arguments without trailing punctuation, and keep raw tokens in JSON. Preserve Reader --all and local JSON golden bytes. Retain strategy, v2 traversal, hint honesty, terminal-signal, and cursor regression tests; document CLI versus MCP continuation fields. Upstream should have the generator emit cursorParam: "page" for page-number endpoints instead of porting the helper-level fallback. Only explicit JSON null marks a page/offset next link terminal; an unextractable non-null link leaves has_more absent. Preserve repeated-next, missing-next empty-page termination, starting-page traversal, embedded-quote hints, and hermetic doctor probes.
